artifacts.name: Expression map · S01-1
artifacts.describe: Gene Expression counts from 360 barcodes were filtered to 359 cells with at least 1 detected genes and positive gene totals; 1 cells were excluded. Counts were normalized to 10000 per cell using all Gene Expression features, then transformed by ln(1+x). Among genes detected in at least 1 retained cells, the 24 selected features were ranked by sample variance (ties by feature ID), centered without variance scaling or clipping, and reduced to 24 nonzero principal components. Exact Euclidean neighborhoods contained 15 other cells, with ties by source barcode order. UMAP used their fuzzy union, PCA initialization, minimum distance 0.5, spread 1, 500 epochs, five negative samples, learning rate 1, repulsion 1 and seed 20261024. The graph has 1 connected components. All effective numerical rules and source fingerprints are recorded. Supplied coordinates and receptor annotations did not enter the fit. This exploratory map does not establish cell types, clonotypes, antigen specificity or subject-level effects.
artifacts.citation: Wolf FA, Angerer P, Theis FJ. SCANPY. Genome Biol. 2018;19:15. doi:10.1186/s13059-017-1382-0; Jolliffe IT, Cadima J. Principal component analysis: a review and recent developments. Phil Trans R Soc A. 2016;374:20150202. doi:10.1098/rsta.2015.0202; McInnes L, Healy J, Melville J. UMAP. 2018. doi:10.48550/arXiv.1802.03426. Variance ranking and PCA initialization are ClonoLoom choices.

artifacts.name: Clonotype phenotypes · S01-1
artifacts.describe: Exact barcode matching linked expression input x-c7f5f2882f8a481393d9be8209787893a576daad709415c94bb02f50bbdbab0a to receptor dataset d-8d1404a8ae498dab, sample S01-1 only. Clonotypes: paired TRA and TRB chains by amino-acid junction, V gene and J gene; single cells by their primary chain of each locus (most UMIs), cells with one chain grouped with cells of the same chain alone. QC: none. Size population: receptor; inclusive breakpoints [1 2 5]. Sizes count uniquely assigned distinct cells, never chain rows. Multiple memberships and conflicting vendor IDs are ambiguous. Phenotype tables include all 360 expression cells (359 mapped), including missing labels. Expanded means size > 1; expansion share is expanded / sized cells. Association fractions use all expression cells of that clone, or all expression cells of that annotation group, including missing annotations. Unassigned and unsized cells have no numeric clone size. Subject "S01"; timepoint "" (empty means missing). Samples are not pooled; cells are not biological replicates. No enrichment test, inferred phenotype or antigen-specificity claim.
artifacts.citation: Sturm G et al. Scirpy. Bioinformatics. 2020;36:4817–4818. doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa611; scirpy.tl.clonal_expansion API (sample groups and inclusive breakpoints); 10x Genomics, Integrated V(D)J and Gene Expression Analysis in Loupe Browser. Distinct-cell counting, ambiguity and denominator rules are ClonoLoom policies; no inferential test.

artifacts.name: Clonotype modularity · S01-1
artifacts.describe: Clonotype modularity for sample S01-1: 358 uniquely assigned cells out of 359 retained expression-graph cells; 3963 induced undirected edges. Counts discard positive fuzzy-weight magnitudes and preserve isolated cells. Score = log2((observed edges + 1)/(expected edges + 1)); expectation is analytic for uniform size-matched subsets. Upper-tail tests include ties: exhaustive for at most 10000 subsets, otherwise 9999 independent Monte Carlo draws with (tail + 1)/(draws + 1), seed 20261024. Benjamini–Yekutieli adjusts all 10 testable clones within this result; singleton and whole-population clones are not tested. Graph population sizes differ from receptor-sample sizes. The fixed graph comes from PCA neighborhoods, never distances on UMAP. Null assumes clone membership exchangeable among eligible cells in this sample; no conditioning on cell type, batch, receptor family or vertex degree. Results can reflect those factors and do not establish antigen specificity, causality, or subject-level effects. Cells are not independent biological replicates. Corrections do not cover repeated choices of graph, QC, definition or sample.
artifacts.citation: scirpy.tl.clonotype_modularity documented connectivity score; Sturm et al. 2020, doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa611. Phipson & Smyth 2010, doi:10.2202/1544-6115.1585; Hemerik & Goeman 2018, doi:10.1007/s11749-017-0571-1 (random permutation tests). Benjamini & Yekutieli 2001, doi:10.1214/aos/1013699998 (FDR under dependence). Population, binary graph and analytic expectation are ClonoLoom policies.

artifacts.name: Receptor / expression neighborhoods · S01-1
artifacts.describe: CoNGA-style comparison in sample S01-1: 358 retained paired cells, 10 clonotype mean-PC profiles, 20 tested clonotype-by-k hypotheses. Exact Euclidean distances on all saved PCs; paired TCRdist (CDR3 only: true; organism: ). Self and shared alpha/beta CDR3s excluded from both candidate pools. Directed neighborhoods include all exact cutoff ties. Conditional uniform-independent-neighbor null; inclusive hypergeometric upper tails and Bonferroni across every tested clone and scale. Null exchangeability is an assumption, not established by the data. No conditioning on cell type, batch or receptor-chain groups. Saved PCs may include receptor genes; their expression can directly couple the two modalities. No UMAP distances, pooled donors, biological replicates, antigen-specificity or causal inference. Repeated analysis choices are not corrected. This is a declared adaptation, not the original CoNGA score or full pipeline.
artifacts.citation: Schattgen et al. 2022, Nature Biotechnology 40:54–63, doi:10.1038/s41587-021-00989-2 (CoNGA); Dash et al. 2017, Nature 547:89–93, doi:10.1038/nature22383; Mayer-Blackwell et al. 2021, doi:10.7554/eLife.68605 (TCRdist3 conventions). Dunn 1961, doi:10.1080/01621459.1961.10482090 (Bonferroni). Mean-PC profiles, shared-CDR3 exclusions, inclusive ties and all-scale Bonferroni are declared ClonoLoom policies; see docs/CONGA.md.

artifacts.name: AnnData export · S01-1
artifacts.describe: Raw sparse integer counts for all input cells and feature modalities, with exact barcode/sample receptor links, assignment and chain status, clone sizes, supplied annotations, and saved embeddings. Missing annotations use categorical code -1; unavailable PCA/UMAP rows are NaN, never zero coordinates. Source and computed coordinates have distinct names. No expression refitting, new biological inference or scirpy raw-chain encoding. Original annotation labels and the complete saved phenotype/map documents, parent manifests, definitions, QC, sample metadata and source fingerprints are in uns/clonoloom. Imported annotations retain their reader's text/missing-value semantics, not original pandas dtypes.
artifacts.citation: AnnData on-disk format specification: https://anndata.readthedocs.io/en/stable/fileformat-prose.html (anndata 0.1.0, dataframe/array/string/categorical 0.2.0, CSR 0.1.0); HDF Group, HDF5 File Format Specification 3.0. ClonoLoom's receptor-link and provenance schema version 1.
